description: This PHP source file defines the Errors class, which provides functionality for creating and managing error-based conditional formatting rules within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for constructing error condition objects, translating conditional types, and handling dynamic method calls related to error conditions.

classes.name: Errors
classes.description: Provides methods to define and manipulate conditional formatting rules based on error conditions within a spreadsheet worksheet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an Errors object for a specified cell range, with an optional inverse flag.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Sets the inverse flag determining whether to look for errors or not errors.

methods.name: getExpression
methods.description: Constructs the conditional expression string for the error condition based on the current state.

methods.name: getConditional
methods.description: Generates and returns a Conditional object configured for error conditional formatting.

methods.name: fromConditional
methods.description: Creates an Errors object from an existing Conditional rule, ensuring it matches error-related condition types.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls related to setting the error condition type (e.g., notError(), isError()).
